name: glibness
lore:
### On the Art of Glibness: The Gilded Tongue

To the observer, *Glibness* manifests as a faint, amber luminescence clinging to the speaker’s throat, like liquid sunlight trapped in gossamer. To the caster, shaping the Weave feels like pouring warm honey over raw silk; it is frictionless, soothing, and deceptively heavy, smoothing every jagged edge of intent into a seamless flow of effortless persuasion.

Legend attributes its discovery to the silver-tongued courtier, Lord Valerius. Facing the gallows for high treason, Valerius did not plead for mercy. Instead, he spoke with such profound, magical resonance that the King not only pardoned him but apologized for the "inconvenience" and handed him the keys to the royal treasury. Valerius vanished that night, leaving behind only a scent of jasmine and a court convinced of his sainthood.

Beware, traveler: when your every word sounds like gospel, truth itself becomes a casualty. Use this enchantment to bridge impossible divides, but remember—the Weave may make your lies sound like gold, but it cannot make them true.
